about: The clip kit's recipes (tools/clips/make.mjs, docs/tools/clips.md). One recipe is one clip: a scene of the capture hook (render/tools/flash_capture.gd) or a mockup script, the seed, the page words, a tick window (from + frames x step) or an event window, a crop of the 960x540 picture, and the encoding. The sim is deterministic, so a recipe gives the same clip on the same build, and moves to a newer build with nobody looking. `nohud=1` hides the HUD on builds whose hook has it; the crops also keep the HUD's corners out, so an older build works too. `strip` (default true): the button strip, one band under the picture (never over it) that lights each control the pad of `stripSlot` (default 0) pressed, with a word under it: tap, hold or mash; it is drawn from the hook's pad log (--no-strip leaves it off; a scene the computer plays, such as `ai`, sets strip false). A recipe with `pending` set is a SLOT for a move that has not landed: `all` skips it and naming it says what it waits for; when the move lands, give it a scene and words and remove `pending`.

events.about: Names a recipe's `event` can use, matched against the sim's own events the hook logs (type, kind). Any other name is read as type or type:kind.

bookmarks.about: Windows (ticks before and after) for the marks and bookmarks of a saved match (make.mjs --from-match): the game's own launch, crater, beam clash end, building fall and KO, and the player's clip button (F9, or View + RB), which marks the last 15 seconds.
